definitions.explanation: A hairstyle in which the head is shaved completely smooth, as a fashion choice. From English "skinhead".

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧スキンヘッドだ。
⟦{思|おも}い{切|き}って→思い切る：04590_omoikiru⟧スキンヘッドにした。
examples.english: I took the plunge and shaved my head completely.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧スキンヘッド⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{涼|すず}しい→涼しい：00674_suzushii⟧し、⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{洗|あら}う→洗う：00827_arau⟧⟦{手間|てま}→手間：03554_tema⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦かからない→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: A shaved head is cooler in summer, and there's no hassle of washing your hair.

notes:
USAGE:
Used with だ and ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: スキンヘッドだ (to have a shaved head), スキンヘッド⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to shave one's head).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{坊主頭|ぼうずあたま}→坊主頭：32951_bouzuatama⟧: close-cropped head, like a monk's (hair cut very short with clippers, not shaved smooth)
- ⟦{丸刈|まるが}り→丸刈り：33044_marugari⟧: crew cut, hair clipped short all over
- はげ: baldness from hair loss (can be rude)

WATCH OUT:
In English "skinhead" can mean a member of a far-right youth subculture; the Japanese word has no such meaning.

cross_references.label: crew cut, hair clipped short all over
